meta.source: Internal Revenue Service, Energy Efficient Home Improvement Credit (section 25C)
meta.notes: Review every three months. As of the check date the federal 25C credit covers only property placed in service through December 31, 2025, so calculators use a federal credit of $0 for a water heater installed now. State and utility rebates vary by place and are not modeled; ENERGY STAR's Rebate Finder lists them.

credits.label: Federal tax credit (25C): heat pump water heaters
credits.source: IRS: 30% of costs, up to $2,000 per year for qualified heat pumps and heat pump water heaters (CEE highest efficiency tier); credit for property placed in service through December 31, 2025

credits.label: Federal tax credit (25C): natural gas, propane or oil water heaters
credits.source: IRS: residential energy property meeting the CEE highest efficiency tier, up to $600 per item; credit for property placed in service through December 31, 2025
